import json,plistlib,subprocess
records=[]
def run(cmd,required=True):
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True)
 records.append({'command':cmd,'exit':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout.decode(),'stderr':r.stderr.decode()})
 if required and r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('read-only command failed: '+str(cmd))
 return r
bad=run(['/usr/sbin/diskutil','info','-plist','/private/tmp'],False)
df=run(['/bin/df','-P','/private/tmp']).stdout.decode()
device=df.splitlines()[-1].split()[0]
info=plistlib.loads(run(['/usr/sbin/diskutil','info','-plist',device]).stdout)
container=info.get('APFSContainerReference') or info.get('ContainerReference')
assert container,sorted(info)
apfs=plistlib.loads(run(['/usr/sbin/diskutil','apfs','list','-plist',container]).stdout)
selected=next(x for x in apfs.get('Containers',[]) if x.get('ContainerReference')==container or x.get('APFSContainerReference')==container)
stores=selected.get('PhysicalStores',[])
physical=[]
for store in stores:
 ident=store.get('DeviceIdentifier')
 if ident:
  detail=plistlib.loads(run(['/usr/sbin/diskutil','info','-plist',ident]).stdout)
  physical.append({k:detail.get(k) for k in ['DeviceIdentifier','ParentWholeDisk','PartOfWhole','BusProtocol','MediaName','SolidState','DiskSize','TotalSize']})
mount=run(['/sbin/mount']).stdout.decode()
summary={'scope':'read-only prospective scratch backing; no files/source copied and no benchmark','scratch':'/private/tmp','df_device':device,'volume':{k:info.get(k) for k in ['DeviceIdentifier','MountPoint','VolumeName','FilesystemType','FilesystemName','Content','APFSContainerReference','TotalSize','VolumeFreeSpace','BusProtocol','SolidState']},'container':container,'physical_stores':stores,'physical_store_info':physical,'mount_lines':[x for x in mount.splitlines() if device+' ' in x],'initial_path_selector_exit':bad.returncode,'selector_resolution':'diskutil does not accept /private/tmp as disk selector; df resolves actual backing device, then diskutil accepts device. Read-only failed command stdout/exit retained.','topology':'Future three voter WAL roots share this one APFS Data volume/container/physical store; not independent-device or three-machine placement. BtrfsCoW/NoCoW are policies on one FS type; APFS is another. No ext4/XFS scratch assumed.'}
assert str(info.get('FilesystemType','')).lower()=='apfs'
